thread:
ada: Heads-up: KiteFall (KF-208) disputed part of INV-2026-0633 for $9,120 (due 2026-04-02). They claim overage charges from a spike caused by a third-party data migration. CFO asking for usage audit + a short payment plan (60/40 over 45 days) while audit completes and a partial waiver of the 7% late fee.

luis: Can you attach the usage logs and the metering report? Need to see the spike windows and whether it matches their maintenance window.

ada: Ledger snippet: ```
invoice: INV-2026-0633
amount: 9120.00
due: 2026-04-02
status: unpaid
dispute_note: customer claims third-party migration spike; requests audit and 60/40 split over 45 days
```

priya: Legal: we can do a conditional partial waiver (up to 7%) if audit verifies at least 50% of the disputed usage was external and they sign the final settlement. Also require a signed short-form payment plan and backup payment method for the balance.

billing-bot: ALERT: KF-208 flagged - PAYMENT_ACTION_REQUIRED (INV-2026-0633). Next automated retry scheduled 2026-04-10.

luis: Ops: I pulled the telemetry. Theres a TTL job between 2026-03-28 02:00-04:00 UTC that correlates with the spike but origin is unclear. I'll hand over raw logs to our usage-audit team.

ops: Note: well run an expedited usage review; if the spike is attributable to our model serving (not third-party), then normal payment terms apply. If it's third-party, consider a one-time credit.

ad a: Draft proposal to customer: 

"Hi KiteFall 
We received your dispute re: INV-2026-0633. We'll run an expedited usage audit (target 7 business days). While audit is in progress we can offer a short payment plan: 60% due on signing, 40% due in 45 days. If the audit confirms >=50% of the disputed usage is attributable to your third-party migration, we'll apply a one-time credit up to 7% of the invoice and settle the remainder per the signed agreement. Please sign here: <link> and provide a backup payment method.

If the audit determines the spike originated on our side, standard terms apply and the dispute will be closed.

Regards, Ada (Billing)"

priya: Approve conditional offer. Include clause: "credit void if customer modifies or cancels plan before audit completion." CC legal on signature.

luis: I'll kick off the usage-audit and attach the report to the billing ticket. ETA 5 business days.

collections: If customer refuses backup payment method or misses the initial 60% on signing, escalate to collections after 7 days. If audit reduces balance, collections holds until settlement finalized.

ad a: billing-bot logged a payment_plan_offer_created (plan_id: PP-2095-KF208) at 2026-04-04T11:04:00Z. Status: pending_customer_signature.

ada: tagging checklist: `start-audit`, `send-agreement`, `attach-backup-method`, `monitor-45d`. Will update thread when audit report attached or customer responds. :thumbsup:
